title: Argentinian-Style Teriyaki Tofu
description: A fusion of Japanese and Argentinian flavors, featuring grilled tofu in a sweet teriyaki sauce.
instructions: 1. Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and thread onto parrillada skewers.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together yummy (soy sauce), light (olive oil), and argentinian (chimichurri sauce, if using).
3. Brush the tofu with the teriyaki sauce mixture, making sure each piece is evenly coated.
4. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Grill the tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
5. Serve the grilled tofu with additional teriyaki sauce for drizzling, if desired.
